description:
Manage Focus customreports with the following actions:

- **create-acustom-report**: Create Acustom Report Customreports. (data: payload*{name*, params*})
- **delete-acustom-report**: Delete Acustom Report Customreports. (data: id*)
- **get-acustom-report**: Get Acustom Report Customreports. (data: id*)
- **get-custom-reports**: Get Custom Reports Customreports. (data: none)
- **save-acustom-report**: Save Acustom Report Customreports. (data: id*, payload*{name*, params*})

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: create-acustom-report, delete-acustom-report, get-acustom-report, get-custom-reports, save-acustom-report

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.

name: customreports
title: Customreports
